Examples in this section assume use of the LE 1M PHY.
For the LE 2M PHY, the packet will be identical except for the longer preamble and longer (in number of bits) Constant Tone Extension.
For the LE Coded PHY, examples of converting from the form used on the uncoded PHYs to those used on the air are shown in Section 2.
Bit sequences are always in transmission order irrespective of spacing.
Decimal and hexadecimal numbers are in their normal form.
The whitening sequence (see [Vol 6] Part B, Section 3.2) depends only on the physical channel index of the channel being used.
The sequence repeats after 127 bits.
